title: synth_tab_health_data
summary: A project exploring synthetic tabular health-data generation methods, comparing probabilistic approaches (Gaussian Copulas, Bayesian Networks) and their differentially-private variants against deep-learning generators like CTGAN. GaussianCopulaSynthesizer from SDV is listed and used as the general baseline synthesizer in this benchmarking work.
